description:
A ranked shortlist of endpoints that do this job, under criteria you choose and the response echoes back. Every term is something the endpoint publishes about itself — its listed price against the going rate, and its own reported demand. Roundhouse does not endorse any provider, and there is no cross-capability ranking. Only confident matches are ever recommended.

Wraps GET /v0/unified/{slug}/recommend.
Access: no API key required.

Returns:
- capability: The registry entry for the job being shortlisted.
- criteria: Your criteria, echoed — a recommendation whose basis is invisible is an opinion.
- price: The capability's going rate, so each candidate's index has context.
- candidates: Ranked endpoints, each with `reasons` for where it placed.
- considered: How many confident offers were ranked before filters.
- excluded: How many were dropped, by which filter.
- truncated: True when the candidate read hit its cap.
- note: What the ranking is and is not — Roundhouse endorses no provider.

limit.description: Rows to return. Clamped to 25; values outside the range are clamped, not rejected.

live.description: Only endpoints answering when last probed.

max_price.description: Hard ceiling in USDC per call. Endpoints with no published price are excluded when set.

model.description: Require the endpoint to name this model family (inference capabilities only).

prefer.description: What to weight: cheapest, most-used, or an even split.

name: recommend_capability_offers
title: Shortlist endpoints for a capability
